dataset_scope.note: Five user-selected DirectorBench prompts; transfer of Short-Drama-Bench metrics, not a reproduction of its 50-prompt dataset.

short_drama.aggregation: mean over valid evaluation units, then equal-weight mean over prompts; one unified judge as explicitly requested

opening_hook.rubric: Evaluate whether the first 10 seconds quickly attract viewers, establish stakes, and create immediate curiosity.

end_hook.rubric: Evaluate whether the scene ending creates sufficient motivation to continue watching.

escalation_effect.rubric: Evaluate whether the middle portion contains effective conflict escalation, rising pressure, or power reversal.

narrative_coherence.rubric: Evaluate whether the story logic remains clear, non-confusing, and internally consistent.

character_spatial_continuity.rubric: Evaluate adjacent clip continuity, including character identity, screen position, body orientation, and spatial relationship continuity.

environment_layout_continuity.rubric: Evaluate adjacent clip continuity, including background layout, room geometry, object placement, and camera-direction consistency.

bgm_emotion_alignment.rubric: Evaluate whether the background music emotion aligns with scene mood, tension, pacing, and dramatic intent.

transition_naturalness.rubric: Evaluate whether the previous scene tail, transition clip, and next scene head connect naturally in action, camera, mood, and story logic.

short_drama.sampling_status: 1 FPS for scene/drama audiovisual judging is an explicit implementation choice: paper does not specify this rate for these metrics.
short_drama.continuity_sampling: last 3 consecutive decoded frames from preceding clip + first 3 consecutive frames from next clip, before final assembly
short_drama.continuity_spacing_status: paper specifies 3+3 frames, not their temporal spacing; consecutive-frame choice is recorded
short_drama.scope_conflict: Section 3.2 describes scene-level hooks/coherence; Figure 10 explicitly defines opening_hook as first 10 seconds of drama and narrative_coherence as drama. Primary follows explicit Figure 10; scene-level versions are supplemental and must be labeled.
short_drama.applicability_adaptation: The educational diagram has no characters. Preserve its six original judge responses but exclude the character spatial-continuity score from primary cross-dataset aggregation. This is an explicit adaptation, not a stated original-paper rule.

vbench.sampling: all decoded frames, native transforms and weights; streamed execution verified against native implementation
vbench.aggregation: native frame weighting for subject/background; mean over videos for motion

replication_gaps: Paper does not release its exact video adaptation or frame-to-scene annotation conversion.
Cross-character consistency must use a specified native identity/embedding criterion; do not substitute an invented 1-5 rating for the published consistency score.
Qwen-scored scene/action alignment uses native ViStoryBench prompt templates and must be labeled as a changed-judge supplementary result.
vistorybench.cross_character_criterion: Native CIDS cids_cross_mean; Hungarian character matching; native face ensemble/CLIP encoders and thresholds
vistorybench.reference_adaptation: No external identity references were provided with these five prompts. Deterministic portraits from first generated appearance clips anchor the metric; this assesses stability against generated anchors, not external identity fidelity.
vistorybench.caption_adaptation: Each 1FPS frame receives its containing planned clip caption; no published per-frame labels are available.
vistorybench.native_single_action_aggregation: Preserves native integer rounding; retains detailed per-character/per-frame scores.
vistorybench.arcface_provider: CPU ONNX; identical antelopev2 weights; native feature mathematics preserved
vistorybench.rate_control: Shared process-safe request pacing and retry cooldown; errors cannot be accepted as zero scores

directorbench.applicability: native dynamic activation; inactive checkpoints are NA, never zero-filled
directorbench.aggregation: native confidence-aware aggregation and profile-weighted score; retain individual checkpoints and tool fallback traces

asr.startup_guard: Local SHA256-validated weights required; ASR FAILED is fatal, not a fallback score

evidence_limitations: MobileViCLIP missing in earlier profiles; affected native scores remain provisional until re-evaluated with model evidence.
ASR success does not establish waveform silence; music and low-confidence transcription can hallucinate.

bgm_consistency.aggregation: Remove metric before native confidence-weighted dimension aggregation and profile-weighted overall normalization.

human_evaluation.requirement: anonymous randomized units, original Likert rubrics, real human scores; no simulated ratings

judge_override.scope: all LLM/VLM judges; native automatic feature metrics keep original encoders
